paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer who likes owning a feature from the database schema to the last React component. My everyday stack is React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Bun and Hono, with MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Redis underneath.

At Louisa AI I worked on an internal release automation platform, taking its GitHub integration phase end to end: backend services, database models, webhooks, APIs for running and monitoring GitHub workflows, and Slack notifications for approvals and failures.

Outside work I build full-stack products such as an AI career coach on Next.js, Clerk, Prisma and Google Gemini, and a MERN e-commerce store with Stripe payments, Redis caching and an admin dashboard.
I studied Computer Science and Engineering at Jadavpur University, have solved 800+ DSA problems across platforms, and serve as a CodeClub member and GFM Coordinator.
